would_be_decisions.text: skills/admin/validation-rules/SKILL.md § Formula Best Practices gave NOT(ISBLANK(StageName)) as the GOOD example for guarding a picklist blank check — the exact form plan.json's inputs.errorConditionFormula carried. An org dry-run probe rejected it: 'Field StageName is a picklist field. Picklist fields are only supported in certain functions.' NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(StageName))) validated 3/3; the same skill's references/llm-anti-patterns.md Anti-Pattern 6 already carried the compiling form ('Use TEXT() to convert picklist to text') for a different field. plan.json.steps[0].amendments[0] corrected the formula to the five-clause TEXT()-wrapped form the same day; the operator's driver's-log entry records the skill fix and a new checker rule, VR-PICK-01, landing in parallel. This is the signal standards/build-orchestration.md § 8 names to deepen a skill, not to freestyle — and here it was an org probe rather than this build's own agents that caught it, because no offline compiler exists for a validation-rule formula.

The label is display text only and nothing references it (the API name, which is load-bearing, is unchanged), so this is a documentation gap rather than a build defect, but it repeats identically on both builder runs and would recur on every future validation-rule-with-bypass step.
